title: RN TradeLab Portfolio Page
author: RNAlgotrading
selftext:
A quick tour of the Portfolio page in RN TradeLab v0.20 - the place where every portfolio you save from a walk-forward backtest lives.   
New in this version: the Trade List. Every trade in the portfolio, in one place:   
\- Sort by any column - date, P&L, exit reason, time held   
\- Group by Symbol - see which stocks carry the portfolio and which drag it down   
\- Group by Date - your best and worst days stand out straight away   
\- Group by Weekday - does the strategy work every day, or is one day quietly giving back the profits?   
\- Filter In-sample / Out-of-sample - if something only looks good in-sample, that's a warning sign, not an edge   
\- Double-click any trade to open it on the chart - entry, exit, stop and target marked on the candles - Export CSV - exactly what you see, filtered and sorted, ready for Excel Also on the page: the out-of-sample metrics, every symbol in the portfolio, and an equity curve with in-sample, out-of-sample and drawdown in one chart.   
  
 v0.20 also introduces Paper Trading - run a tested strategy against live, real-time data with zero risk before any real money is involved.

comments.author: Shoddy_Peanut7320
comments.body: Having the in-sample and out-of-sample split right in the trade list, and warning that a good in-sample result alone isn't an edge, is a useful habit for users. One addition worth considering is a tag for trades near scheduled events like earnings, CPI and FOMC, so users can see whether the results depend on a few news days. Cymetica's EventTrader is one source of that timing data. Good luck with v0.20.
